periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique axis tilted approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane, directed toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elliptical morphology with a vertical major axis; ratio is approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering toward the inferior-lateral aspect of the muzzle.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-ear gap is approximately 1.8 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Continuous semicircular curvature with a highly smooth apex profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Bilateral manual grasping of two brown food objects; pronounced upward curvature of the oral commissure.
